title: Golden Wings
description: This is a simple re-texture of the elytra to look like golden wings. This was made for Pseudocyance.
body: This is just a simple re-texture of the elytra to make it loook like a pair of golden wings instead of the normal grey wings. This was made as umcytblrsexyman Tango propagand in exchange for a Tango vote from Pseudocyance.
